quote: Till rising and gliding out I wander’d off by myself, / In the mystical moist night-air, and from time to time, / Look’d up in perfect silence at the stars.
source: Walt Whitman, When I Heard the Learn’d Astronomer, the closing three lines, Leaves of Grass, By the Roadside
note: Corrected the edition. The Project Gutenberg text read this run carries no edition statement, numbers the two annexes as Books XXXIV and XXXV, and omits A Backward Glance, so it is not the 1891 to 1892 printing. Book XX belongs to the later David McKay arrangement and is dropped. The wording matches exactly.

evidence.where: I downloaded Project Gutenberg ebook 1322 and read the poem myself this run at line 8906; the three closing lines match character for character, including both elisions, the hyphen in night-air, the comma after from time to time, and the closing full stop. I then checked the file’s structure: BOOK XXXIV. SANDS AT SEVENTY at line 16318 and BOOKXXXV. GOOD-BYE MY FANCY at line 17295 number the two annexes into the main sequence, and a search of the whole file finds no A Backward Glance o’er Travel’d Roads. The front matter gives no edition statement. A separate search confirms the numbered Book arrangement, with By the Roadside as Book XX, belongs to the later David McKay printing
evidence.edition: Leaves of Grass; the file read is the numbered Book arrangement of the later David McKay printing, not the 1891 to 1892 deathbed edition. The poem first appeared in Drum-Taps, 1865, and By the Roadside is its cluster in every later arrangement
evidence.locator: the last three of the poem’s eight lines, in the By the Roadside cluster

reason: The refutation is upheld and I confirmed each of its structural tells on the file myself. The wording is exact and needs no change, so the line ships; what was false was the edition named in the earlier verdict, since Book XX numbering and the 1891 to 1892 deathbed edition cannot both be true of one text. Dropping the Book number leaves a locator that is true of the poem in every arrangement from 1871 onward, which is what the standard asks for. shipped.js returns no match and no near match, Whitman stands at 0 of 3, and he is not banned. The line is in scope, publishable, and squarely on the month’s theme.
